SRC-081:R002.text: Do not falsify provenance by pretending they were present in the immutable audit/11 source document or SRC-080 source bytes.

SRC-081:R003.text: do not block productive implementation merely because append support itself is incomplete.

SRC-081:R004.text: Do not manually rewrite immutable historical receipts or LOG entries.

SRC-081:R005.text: They must behave like real AUDAPACK launchers, not decorative custom entries.

SRC-081:R007.text: Do not collapse Claude 1 and Claude 2 into one launcher identity.

SRC-081:R008.text: A normal click on Claude 1 must never focus Claude 2.

SRC-081:R009.text: A normal click on Claude 2 must never focus Claude 1.

SRC-081:R010.text: Do not silently launch a GUI product when a functional CLI/TUI path exists.

SRC-081:R011.text: Do not perform network installation automatically.

SRC-081:R013.text: Do not copy authentication state between accounts.

SRC-081:R014.text: Do not overwrite provider configuration merely to make discovery easier.

SRC-081:R015.text: Claude 1 and Claude 2 must be real distinct launch targets.

SRC-081:R016.text: The implementation must discover and use the machine's existing profile/account isolation mechanism.

SRC-081:R017.text: Do not assume that two invocations of a generic `claude` command automatically represent two accounts.
